title: Decademy
description: My project is based on decentralized education platform where we have removed the centralized storage system, content of the course is stored on the skynet, which can be accessed easily. each nft token is represent the course of particular author which can be transfered to leaner account on receiving payment
how_its_made: i have built this project using solidity for writing smart contract , Nft tokens for the representation of each course , skynet for storing the content of the course and matic for faster transaction. by combining all these we have made education platform which provide authentic content , maintain security  and fulltime accessibility of the content
